test_cases.name: Missing Deterministic File Handle Disposal
test_cases.rationale: Opens file descriptor directly without 'with' block or try/finally close.

test_cases.name: Exception Bypassing Manual Stream Cleanup
test_cases.rationale: FileInputStream.close() is bypassed when parseHeader throws an exception.

test_cases.name: Partial Multi-Resource Acquisition Failure Leaking First Resource
test_cases.rationale: FileStream is orphaned if subsequent TcpClient constructor fails.

test_cases.name: Resource Disposed While Async Work Remains In-Flight
test_cases.rationale: Releases database connection in finally while unawaited async task is actively using it.

test_cases.name: Lock Acquired Without Finally Block Causing Deadlock
test_cases.rationale: Lock is acquired manually without try/finally or with statement, deadlocking on exception.

test_cases.name: Re-instantiating Connection Pool / HTTP Client in Loop
test_cases.rationale: Instantiates new HttpClient per iteration leading to socket exhaustion in TIME_WAIT.

test_cases.name: Subprocess Abandoned Without Termination
test_cases.rationale: Spawns Popen without wait/timeout/termination, leaving zombie process on failure.

test_cases.name: Leaked Temporary File on Processing Failure
test_cases.rationale: Creates temp file without deleteOnExit or finally deletion, leaking disk space on error.

test_cases.name: Unregistered Timer Callback Preventing Garbage Collection
test_cases.rationale: Registers recurring timer and event bus listener without dispose/cleanup method.

test_cases.name: Test Fixture Leaking Persistent Temporary State
test_cases.rationale: Test creates filesystem directory and file without tearDown cleanup.

test_cases.name: Safe Resource Lifecycle Management with Idiomatic Scopes
test_cases.rationale: Uses RAII and context managers to guarantee cleanup of locks and temp files.
